desc.zh: 朝鲜要为产业与道路筹资，东明的放款人可以接洽。但在资本到达之前，账目、担保与偿付次序必须先谈定；谈不成，本国仍可自筹小规模方案。
desc.en: Korea seeks funds for industry and roads, and Dongming's lenders may be approached. Before capital arrives, the accounts, the collateral and the repayment order must be settled; if they are not, a small self-funded plan remains.

desc.zh: 东明的放款人要求先看账。朝鲜可以提交已经结算的旧账作为信用，也可以只交本年度账目；无论提交哪一种，账目都必须经得起核对。
desc.en: The Dongming lender asks for books first. Korea may present settled prior accounts as credit or hand over only the current year's ledger; either way the books must survive an audit.

events.immediate: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_delivery_1400 = yes } remove_variable = ywc_t09_pending if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_t09_popup_epoch } } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } save_scope_value_as = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch value = var:ywc_t09_popup_epoch } ywc_v03_mark_major_delivered = yes } }

consequence_note.zh: 已结算的军账与学账记录呈交东明，等待放款人审查。
consequence_note.en: The settled military and school account records go to Dongming; the lender's review follows.

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_at_1400 = yes ywc_t09_partner_current = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_mode value = 2 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_stage value = 1401 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1401 } c:DMG = { set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1401 } } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 本年度账目呈交东明，没有旧账为凭，审查将更严格。
consequence_note.en: The current ledger goes to Dongming; without settled prior accounts, scrutiny will be stricter.

label.zh: 不借贷，自筹小规模方案
label.en: Fund a small plan at home instead

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_at_1400 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_mode value = 3 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_proposed_outcome value = 2 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_stage value = 1406 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1406 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

cost_note.zh: 无额外国库支出；规模以现有经费为限。
cost_note.en: No additional treasury expense; the scale is capped by existing funds.

consequence_note.zh: 不向东明借贷，改以现有经费自筹小规模方案，直接进入项目定夺。
consequence_note.en: No loan from Dongming; a small self-funded plan goes straight to the project decision.

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_at_1400 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1400 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 记录本次决定。
consequence_note.en: Records this decision.

purpose.zh: 需资国核对自身账目与预算压力，决定以何种信用面见资金方，或改行自筹。
purpose.en: The capital-seeking country audits its own accounts and budget pressure, then chooses the credit it presents to the funder or turns to self-funding.

writes: KOR stage 1401 and pending 1401 with DMG pending 1401, or self-funded stage 1406

desc.zh: 东明的账房核对朝鲜送来的簿册。自家预算在册、对方账目又有旧账为凭，可以不取担保直接放款；否则须以税权作保，也可以拒绝。
desc.en: Dongming's clerks audit the books Korea sent. With its own budget on record and the borrower's settled prior accounts, it may lend without collateral; otherwise it demands tax rights or declines.

events.immediate: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_dmg_delivery_1401 = yes } remove_variable = ywc_t09_pending if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_t09_popup_epoch } } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } save_scope_value_as = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch value = var:ywc_t09_popup_epoch } ywc_v03_mark_major_delivered = yes } }

label.zh: 认账放款，须以税权作保
label.en: Approve the loan against tax rights

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_dmg_at_1401 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_lender_terms value = 1 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } c:KOR = { set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_partner_terms value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_stage value = 1402 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1402 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } } }

consequence_note.zh: 审查通过但要求以税权作保，条款送交朝鲜定夺。
consequence_note.en: The review passes with tax rights as collateral; the terms go to Korea.

options.trigger: { ywc_t09_dmg_at_1401 = yes ywc_t09_funder_books = yes c:KOR ?= { var:ywc_t09_mode ?= 1 } }
options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_dmg_at_1401 = yes ywc_t09_funder_books = yes c:KOR ?= { var:ywc_t09_mode ?= 1 } } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_lender_terms value = 2 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } c:KOR = { set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_partner_terms value = 2 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_stage value = 1402 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1402 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } } }

consequence_note.zh: 自家预算在册且对方旧账可信，按无担保条款放款。
consequence_note.en: With its own budget records and the borrower's settled books, the loan proceeds unsecured.

label.en: Fail the review and decline the loan

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_dmg_at_1401 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_lender_terms value = 4 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } c:KOR = { set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_partner_terms value = 4 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_proposed_outcome value = 3 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_stage value = 1407 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1407 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } } }

consequence_note.zh: 账目不足以支持放款，东明婉拒；朝鲜按账自行结算。
consequence_note.en: The books do not support a loan; Dongming declines and Korea settles on its own ledger.

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_dmg_at_1401 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1401 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 记录本次决定。
consequence_note.en: Records this decision.

purpose.zh: 资金方以自家预算册与对方信用决定放款条件，或拒绝。
purpose.en: The funder sets the lending terms against its own budget records and the borrower's credit, or declines.

reads: KOR stage and presented ledger mode
DMG own budget records ywc_dmg_crown_budget / ywc_dmg_market_budget / ywc_dmg_school_budget
writes: lender terms record with KOR mirror
KOR stage 1402 and pending 1402, or KOR stage 1407 with proposed refusal

desc.zh: 东明的条款送到了：以税权作保，或只以港口关税为限，或按无担保条款接受。押上多少，将来不能偿付时失去的就有多少；不押则回到自筹。
desc.en: Dongming's terms have arrived: tax rights as collateral, port customs alone, or unsecured acceptance. What is pledged is what is forfeited on default; refusing means returning to self-funding.

events.immediate: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_delivery_1402 = yes } remove_variable = ywc_t09_pending if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_t09_popup_epoch } } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } save_scope_value_as = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch value = var:ywc_t09_popup_epoch } ywc_v03_mark_major_delivered = yes } }

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_at_1402 = yes ywc_t09_partner_current = yes var:ywc_t09_partner_terms ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_collateral value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_stage value = 1403 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1403 } c:DMG = { set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1403 } } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 税权押作担保，等待第一期拨款；违约时按押失去税权。
consequence_note.en: Tax rights stand as collateral pending the first disbursement; default forfeits them.

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_at_1402 = yes ywc_t09_partner_current = yes var:ywc_t09_partner_terms ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_collateral value = 2 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_stage value = 1403 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1403 } c:DMG = { set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1403 } } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 只以港口关税为限作保，担保成色较低，拨款或被减半。
consequence_note.en: Port customs alone stand as collateral; the weaker pledge may halve the disbursement.

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_at_1402 = yes ywc_t09_partner_current = yes var:ywc_t09_partner_terms ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_collateral value = 3 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_stage value = 1403 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1403 } c:DMG = { set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1403 } } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 按无担保条款接受，凭旧账信用等待拨款。
consequence_note.en: The unsecured terms stand on the settled-books credit pending disbursement.

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_at_1402 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_proposed_outcome value = 2 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_stage value = 1406 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1406 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 拒绝外部担保条款，保留税权，改以现有经费自筹小规模方案。
consequence_note.en: The outside collateral terms are refused and tax rights are kept; a small self-funded plan proceeds instead.

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_at_1402 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1402 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 记录本次决定。
consequence_note.en: Records this decision.

purpose.zh: 需资国决定以何种担保接受条款，或拒绝条款回到自筹。
purpose.en: The capital-seeking country decides which collateral secures the terms, or refuses them and returns to self-funding.

writes: KOR stage 1403 and pending 1403 with DMG pending 1403, or self-funded stage 1406

desc.zh: 东明的账房按担保成色拨付第一期：押了税权可足额，未押或只押关税则减半。库中无钱或另有顾虑，也可以暂不拨款。
desc.en: Dongming's clerks size the first disbursement to the collateral: full with tax rights pledged, half otherwise. Short of funds or for other reasons, it may also withhold.

events.immediate: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_dmg_delivery_1403 = yes } remove_variable = ywc_t09_pending if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_t09_popup_epoch } } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } save_scope_value_as = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch value = var:ywc_t09_popup_epoch } ywc_v03_mark_major_delivered = yes } }

label.en: Disburse the first installment in full

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_dmg_at_1403 = yes gold_reserves >= 800 c:KOR ?= { var:ywc_t09_collateral ?= 1 } } add_treasury = -800 set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_lender_disburse value = 1 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } c:KOR = { add_treasury = 800 set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_partner_disburse value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_stage value = 1404 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1404 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } } }

cost_note.zh: 东明国库支付 800；朝鲜国库入账 800。
cost_note.en: Dongming pays 800 from its treasury; Korea receives 800.

consequence_note.zh: 第一期资本到达朝鲜，账目两边各记一份，等待偿付之期。
consequence_note.en: The first installment reaches Korea and both ledgers record it; the repayment date follows.

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_dmg_at_1403 = yes gold_reserves >= 400 } add_treasury = -400 set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_lender_disburse value = 2 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } c:KOR = { add_treasury = 400 set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_partner_disburse value = 2 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_stage value = 1404 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1404 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } } }

cost_note.zh: 东明国库支付 400；朝鲜国库入账 400。
cost_note.en: Dongming pays 400 from its treasury; Korea receives 400.

consequence_note.zh: 减半拨款到达朝鲜，项目规模须相应缩减。
consequence_note.en: The halved installment reaches Korea; the project scale must shrink accordingly.

label.en: Withhold the disbursement and hold the terms

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_dmg_at_1403 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_lender_disburse value = 4 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } c:KOR = { set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_partner_disburse value = 4 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_proposed_outcome value = 3 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_stage value = 1407 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1407 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } } }

consequence_note.zh: 担保成色不足，东明暂不拨款，朝鲜按账自行结算。
consequence_note.en: The collateral does not justify disbursement; Dongming withholds and Korea settles on its own ledger.

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_dmg_at_1403 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1403 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 记录本次决定。
consequence_note.en: Records this decision.

purpose.zh: 资金方按担保成色与自身库款拨付第一期资本，或暂不拨款。
purpose.en: The funder sizes and pays the first installment against the collateral and its own treasury, or withholds it.

writes: lender disbursement record with KOR mirror
treasury transfer 800 or 400 from DMG to KOR
KOR stage 1404 and pending 1404, or KOR stage 1407 with proposed refusal

title.en: The Due Date Meets a Lean Harvest

desc.zh: 还款之期恰逢歉收，市面紧缩。可以求东明展期，可以咬牙按期付本息，也可以据实记入欠账、准备缩减项目。
desc.en: Repayment falls in a lean harvest and the market tightens. Korea may ask Dongming for an extension, pay the installment anyway, or record the arrears and prepare to shrink the project.

events.immediate: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_delivery_1404 = yes } remove_variable = ywc_t09_pending if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_t09_popup_epoch } } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } save_scope_value_as = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch value = var:ywc_t09_popup_epoch } ywc_v03_mark_major_delivered = yes } }

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_at_1404 = yes ywc_t09_partner_current = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_repay value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_stage value = 1405 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1405 } c:DMG = { set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1405 } } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 展期之请连同欠账记录送交东明，等待债权人预算定夺。
consequence_note.en: The extension request and the arrears record go to Dongming; the creditor's budget decides.

label.en: Pay the installment on time anyway

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_at_1404 = yes ywc_t09_partner_current = yes gold_reserves >= 500 } add_treasury = -500 set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_repay value = 2 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_stage value = 1406 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1406 } c:DMG = { add_treasury = 500 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

cost_note.zh: 朝鲜国库支付 500；东明国库入账 500。
cost_note.en: Korea pays 500 from its treasury; Dongming receives 500.

consequence_note.zh: 本息按期付清，账目两边各记一份，进入项目定夺。
consequence_note.en: The installment is paid on time and both ledgers record it; the project decision follows.

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_at_1404 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_repay value = 3 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_stage value = 1406 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1406 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 欠账据实入册，项目准备缩减，不再向东明转款。
consequence_note.en: The arrears enter the ledger, the project is prepared for shrinking, and no funds move to Dongming.

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_at_1404 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1404 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 记录本次决定。
consequence_note.en: Records this decision.

purpose.zh: 需资国在偿付之期决定展期、付清或如实记欠。
purpose.en: The capital-seeking country decides at the due date to request an extension, pay up, or record honest arrears.

writes: treasury service payment 500 from KOR to DMG
KOR stage 1405 and pending 1405 with DMG pending 1405, or self stage 1406

title.en: The Creditor Also Has a Budget

desc.zh: 东明自己的预算也有盈缺。库中有余可以自担展期成本；无余则记账收取展期息费；再不济按原条款索偿。
desc.en: Dongming's own budget has its own shortfalls. With surplus it can absorb the extension's cost; without, it books a service fee; otherwise it holds to the original terms.

events.immediate: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_dmg_delivery_1405 = yes } remove_variable = ywc_t09_pending if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_t09_popup_epoch } } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } save_scope_value_as = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch value = var:ywc_t09_popup_epoch } ywc_v03_mark_major_delivered = yes } }

label.en: Grant the extension and absorb the cost

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_dmg_at_1405 = yes gold_reserves >= 200 } add_treasury = -200 set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_lender_coop value = 1 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } c:KOR = { set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_partner_coop value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_stage value = 1406 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1406 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } } }

cost_note.zh: 东明国库支付 200；不向朝鲜转款。
cost_note.en: Dongming pays 200; no transfer to Korea.

consequence_note.zh: 展期获准，成本由债权人预算自担，账目两边各记一份。
consequence_note.en: The extension is granted at the creditor's own expense and both ledgers record it.

label.en: Extend with a booked service fee

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_dmg_at_1405 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_lender_coop value = 2 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } c:KOR = { set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_partner_coop value = 2 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_stage value = 1406 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1406 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } } }

consequence_note.zh: 展期获准但息费记账在册，随账目一并结算。
consequence_note.en: The extension is granted with the fee booked and settled with the accounts.

label.zh: 拒绝展期，按原条款索偿
label.en: Refuse the extension and hold the original terms

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_dmg_at_1405 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_lender_coop value = 3 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } c:KOR = { set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_partner_coop value = 3 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_stage value = 1406 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1406 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } } }

consequence_note.zh: 展期被拒，原条款仍然有效，朝鲜须自行定夺项目。
consequence_note.en: The extension is refused; the original terms stand and Korea decides on the project itself.

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_dmg_at_1405 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1405 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 记录本次决定。
consequence_note.en: Records this decision.

purpose.zh: 资金方按自身预算决定展期的成本承担方式，或拒绝展期。
purpose.en: The funder decides how its own budget bears the extension's cost, or refuses the extension.

reads: KOR extension request and arrears record
writes: creditor cooperation record with KOR mirror

desc.zh: 朝鲜按自己的账目定夺：东明准了展期即可续办；无论对方如何答复，都可以把项目缩到现有经费能承担的规模，或者就此终止合作。两边账册各自独立记下这次决定。
desc.en: Korea decides on its own books: a granted extension lets the project continue; whatever the creditor answered, the project may shrink to what existing funds carry, or the arrangement may end. Each ledger records the decision independently.

events.immediate: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_delivery_1406 = yes } remove_variable = ywc_t09_pending if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_t09_popup_epoch } } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } save_scope_value_as = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch value = var:ywc_t09_popup_epoch } ywc_v03_mark_major_delivered = yes } }

label.en: Continue the project on extended terms

options.trigger: { ywc_t09_kor_at_1406 = yes var:ywc_t09_repay ?= 1 OR = { var:ywc_t09_partner_coop ?= 1 var:ywc_t09_partner_coop ?= 2 } }
options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_at_1406 = yes var:ywc_t09_repay ?= 1 OR = { var:ywc_t09_partner_coop ?= 1 var:ywc_t09_partner_coop ?= 2 } } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_proposed_outcome value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_stage value = 1407 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1407 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 依获准的展期条款续办项目，等待结案。
consequence_note.en: The project continues on the granted extension pending the close.

label.en: Shrink the project to a self-funded scale

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_at_1406 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_proposed_outcome value = 2 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_stage value = 1407 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1407 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 项目缩到现有经费能承担的规模，欠账记录保留在册。
consequence_note.en: The project shrinks to what existing funds carry and the arrears record stands.

label.en: End the arrangement and settle the accounts

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_at_1406 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_proposed_outcome value = 3 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_stage value = 1407 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1407 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 终止与东明的借贷合作，已付费用不退。
consequence_note.en: The lending arrangement with Dongming ends; expenses already paid are not refunded.

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_at_1406 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1406 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 记录本次决定。
consequence_note.en: Records this decision.

purpose.zh: 需资国独立定夺项目续办、缩减或终止；两边账册各自记录。
purpose.en: The capital-seeking country independently continues, shrinks or ends the project; both ledgers keep their own record.

reads: extension request and creditor answer records on KOR

desc.zh: 账目终须结清。按双方记录结案：足额履行、有限收束或记为拒贷；东明已不可联系时，朝鲜按已有账目自行收束。偿付之外的制度——担保的边界与对账的规矩——由这次记录留存。
desc.en: The books must close. Settle on the joint record: full performance, a limited close, or refused credit. If Dongming is unavailable, Korea closes on the accounts it holds. Beyond repayment, the institutions—the bounds of collateral and the rules of reconciliation—remain on record.

events.immediate: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_delivery_1407 = yes } remove_variable = ywc_t09_pending if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_t09_popup_epoch } } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } save_scope_value_as = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch value = var:ywc_t09_popup_epoch } ywc_v03_mark_major_delivered = yes } }

label.en: Close the ledger as full performance

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_at_1407 = yes var:ywc_t09_proposed_outcome ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_outcome value = 1 } change_relations = { country = c:DMG value = 5 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } c:DMG = { set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_standing value = 1 } } } }

consequence_note.zh: 足额履行入册结案，东明对朝鲜关系增加 5。
consequence_note.en: Full performance closes the ledger; Dongming gains 5 relations with Korea.

label.en: Close the ledger as a limited close

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_at_1407 = yes var:ywc_t09_proposed_outcome ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_outcome value = 2 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } c:DMG = { set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_standing value = 2 } } } }

consequence_note.zh: 有限收束入册结案：自筹方案或未竟的贷款按实结算。
consequence_note.en: A limited close settles the ledger on the self-funded plan or the unfinished loan.

label.en: Close the ledger as refused credit

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_at_1407 = yes var:ywc_t09_proposed_outcome ?= 3 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_outcome value = 3 } change_relations = { country = c:DMG value = -5 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } c:DMG = { set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_standing value = 3 } } } }

consequence_note.zh: 拒贷入册结案，东明对朝鲜关系减少 5。
consequence_note.en: Refused credit closes the ledger; Dongming loses 5 relations with Korea.

label.zh: 东明已不可联系，按账自行收束
label.en: Close locally because the creditor is unavailable

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_at_1407 = yes NOT = { ywc_t09_partner_current = yes } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_t09_partner_terms } } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_outcome value = 4 } } else_if = { limit = { var:ywc_t09_partner_terms ?= 4 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_outcome value = 3 } } else = { set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_outcome value = 2 } } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 对方已不可联系，朝鲜按已有账目自行收束；已支付的费用不退。
consequence_note.en: The creditor is unavailable; Korea closes on the accounts it holds. Expenses already paid are not refunded.

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t09_kor_at_1407 = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_t09_pending value = 1407 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t09_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 记录本次决定。
consequence_note.en: Records this decision.

purpose.zh: 需资国按双方记录结案，并把担保与对账的制度留在册上。
purpose.en: The capital-seeking country closes the arc on the joint record and leaves the collateral and reconciliation institutions on the books.

reads: proposed outcome and lender records on KOR
